title: Before you speak an answer, please read this.

items.label: What is recorded
items.text: When you choose to answer by voice on a call, we record what you say, from when you tap Record until you tap Stop. Nothing else: not before, not after, not on any other call.

items.label: It is your choice every time
items.text: Each call asks again. Saying no never changes your pay or whether you are rung.

items.label: What the asker gets
items.text: The words you said and their timing. The recording itself only if you say yes on that call's screen.

items.label: What nobody may do with it
items.text: Nobody, we or the asker, may use your recording to tell who you are, compare your voice with any other, clone it, or train any speech or voice model. We never make a voiceprint.

items.label: How long
items.text: Recordings are deleted 90 days after the call closes, or sooner if you ask; a rule in our storage deletes them on time. Words written from a recording are kept like your typed answers (up to 13 months).

items.label: Who writes the words
items.text: None is named yet. Until one is named, a spoken answer is kept as "transcript pending" and only its length reaches the asker.

items.label: Changing your mind
items.text: You can delete any recording, or all of them, from your page at any time.
